note: Colorado's 17 no_catalog rows. 7 added, 10 excluded. Dated Campendium and Dyrt rig reports carried the size gate for the BLM river camps that publish no length.

added.name: Hall Valley Campground (Webster Pass Road)
added.caveat: spurs 16-30 ft; water system shut since 2020

added.name: Meadow Ridge Campground (Meadow Lake, White River NF)
The Gate Campground (Lake Fork of the Gunnison)

excluded.name: Cottonwood Grove Campground (Gunnison Gorge)
excluded.why: RVs/trailers to 25 ft at most, at the end of a narrow canyon dirt road that is hazardous when wet; high clearance advised

excluded.name: Grandview Campground (Long Draw Reservoir)
excluded.why: tents-only, walk-in sites from a common lot

excluded.name: Jouflas Campground (Rabbit Valley)
excluded.why: the Rabbit Valley catalog (10227416) gives Jouflas sites no length and aggregators call it tent-focused. LEAD: the same facility's Fluffle loop lists 25 standard and group-RV sites at 60 ft - a candidate add in its own right

excluded.name: Knowles Overlook Campground (Rabbit Valley)
excluded.why: RIDB: 'High clearance is recommended and nothing over 35 feet'

excluded.name: North Fork Campground (Salida)
excluded.why: 'not recommended for vehicles towing trailers. High clearance vehicles are a requirement'

excluded.name: Rainbow Lakes Campground (Nederland)
excluded.why: tents and small trailers only at the end of a rough road

excluded.name: Red Bridge Campground (Lake Fork)
excluded.why: BLM gives no length; reviewers describe very tight sites and only a van-sized rig; an aggregator's '30 ft' has no source

excluded.name: Thompson Creek Campground (Carbondale)
excluded.why: 4 undeveloped creekside sites, no tables or toilets, pack out human waste, access not recommended wet; no source says an RV fits
